component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.grid = m.top.findNode("grid") m.grid.content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") m.grid.observeField("itemFocused", "onItemFocused") m.buttons = m.top.findNode("buttons") m.focused = 0 end sub
sub onStep() action = m.top.step if action = "populateGrid" populateGrid() else if action = "appendGrid" appendGrid() else if action = "setupButtons" setupButtons() else moveButtons(action) end if end sub
sub onItemFocused() print " itemFocused = "; m.grid.itemFocused; " count = "; m.grid.content.getChildCount() end sub
sub fill(count as integer) for i = 1 to count m.grid.content.createChild("ContentNode") end for end sub
sub populateGrid() m.grid.setFocus(true) m.grid.jumpToItem = 0 fill(6) print "populate returned: itemFocused = "; m.grid.itemFocused end sub
sub appendGrid() m.grid.jumpToItem = 3 fill(2) print "append returned: itemFocused = "; m.grid.itemFocused end sub
sub logGrid(label as string) print label; ": itemFocused = "; m.grid.itemFocused end sub
sub setupButtons() for i = 0 to 3 button = m.buttons.createChild("Group") button.id = "b" + i.toStr() button.focusable = true button.observeField("focusedChild", "onButtonFocus") end for m.buttons.observeField("focusedChild", "onRowFocus") m.top.findNode("outlet").observeField("focusedChild", "onOutletFocus") m.restoreArmed = false m.buttons.getChild(0).setFocus(true) logButtons("setup") end sub
' Paints a button's focus border the way JellyRock's IconButton does: from hasFocus(). sub onButtonFocus(event as object) button = event.getRoSGNode() button.addFields({ border: button.hasFocus() }) button.border = button.hasFocus() end sub
' JRButtonGroup: holding the focus itself, it forwards it to the current button. sub onRowFocus() if m.buttons.hasFocus() then m.buttons.getChild(m.focused).setFocus(true) end sub
' sgRouter's outlet: losing the chain it last had, it re-focuses the view's saved node (the row). sub onOutletFocus(event as object) inChain = event.getData() <> invalid if not inChain and m.restoreArmed then m.buttons.setFocus(true) m.restoreArmed = inChain end sub
sub moveButtons(key as string) target = m.focused + 1 if key = "left" then target = m.focused - 1 m.buttons.getChild(m.focused).setFocus(false) m.focused = target m.buttons.getChild(target).setFocus(true) logButtons(key) end sub
sub logButtons(label as string) line = label + ":" for i = 0 to m.buttons.getChildCount() - 1 button = m.buttons.getChild(i) line = line + " " + button.id + "=" + button.hasFocus().toStr() + "/" + button.border.toStr() end for print line end sub
